title: Tick Identification Pilot Program Act of 2025
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
summary:
Tick Identification Pilot Program Act of 2025

This bill authorizes the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to award grants to states to implement tick-identification programs, which must allow individuals to electronically report tick incidents and receive feedback from experts regarding the appropriate follow-up action.
